title: Hypothesis Bundle
description: Schema for HDD hypothesis bundles in /algo-strategy workflow

cause.description: Market condition or signal that triggers action

effect.description: Expected price behavior following the cause

why.description: Economic/behavioral rationale connecting cause to effect

when.description: Regime condition under which hypothesis is valid

trend_filter.description: Price position relative to 200-day moving average

volatility_regime.description: Allowed volatility regimes for this hypothesis

atr_percentile_max.description: Maximum ATR percentile (e.g., 75 = exclude HIGH regime)

testability_score.description: How testable is this hypothesis (0.7 minimum required)

params_locked.description: Locked parameter values that cannot change under this hypothesis

trial_number.description: Current trial count (resets on new hypothesis)

mentioned_indicators.description: Indicators mentioned in hypothesis for consistency checking
